name: Small Town Rockin' Christmas in Downtown Inverness
host: City of Inverness with the Rotary Club of Downtown Inverness
paras: Small Town Rockin' Christmas is a free holiday celebration in Downtown Inverness on Saturday, November 28, 2026, from 5 to 9 PM. The City of Inverness presents it with the Rotary Club of Downtown Inverness as the kickoff to the city's 12 Days of Christmas event series.

The downtown Christmas tree is lit at 6:45 PM on the Square. Live performances by the Salvation Army Band, the Hernando Harmonizers and A Rockin' Blue Christmas with Johnny Rogers follow on stage from 7 to 9 PM.
Families can visit with Santa Claus at the Old Historic Courthouse Museum.
tip: Arrive before the 6:45 PM tree lighting, then see Santa at the Old Historic Courthouse Museum.

name: Light Up Liberty Holiday Celebration and Boat Parade in Inverness
address: Liberty Park, N. Apopka Avenue, Inverness, FL 34450
paras: Light Up Liberty is the City of Inverness' annual free holiday celebration for the whole family, held at Liberty Park on Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 5 to 8 PM.
The evening counts down to the lighting of the Christmas tree and the decorated lamp posts. The Holiday Boat Parade, hosted by Bluewater Drafting, begins at 5:45 PM.
Families can visit with Santa Claus, join holiday crafts and activities, buy food from local vendors and browse gifts and seasonal finds at a special holiday market.
tip: Find a spot at the water before the boat parade starts at 5:45 PM.

name: Movie Night at Liberty Park: The Polar Express in Inverness
host: City of Inverness Parks and Recreation
address: Liberty Park, N. Apopka Avenue, Inverness, FL 34450
paras: The City of Inverness invites families to a free outdoor showing of The Polar Express (2004) at Liberty Park on Friday, December 4, 2026, beginning at approximately 6 PM.
Guests bring blankets, lawn chairs and picnic baskets for a family friendly evening under the stars. Food and other vendors are on site, and admission is free.
The film follows a young boy on Christmas Eve who rides the Polar Express to the North Pole and learns about friendship, bravery and the spirit of Christmas.
tip: Bring blankets or lawn chairs and a picnic basket.

name: 2026 Inverness Christmas Parade
host: Citrus County Chamber of Commerce, listed by the City of Inverness
address: Downtown Inverness, 207 Courthouse Square, Inverness, FL 34450
paras: The 2026 Inverness Christmas Parade rolls through downtown Inverness on Saturday, December 12, 2026, at noon. The Citrus County Chamber of Commerce produces it, and this year's theme is Nature Coast Christmas.
The theme invites floats with manatees in Santa hats, Christmas trees beside the springs, decorated fishing boats and woodland wildlife, along with marching bands and the arrival of Santa.

The parade enters W. Main Street near Dunkin' Donuts, heads east toward downtown, turns onto E. Grace Street past Mama's Kuntry Kafe, continues toward HCA Florida Citrus Hospital and then onto S. Line Avenue and W. Highland Boulevard, ending at Citrus High School.

Road closures begin at about 10:45 AM and last until about 2 PM. Main Street is closed from Hwy. 44 East to Montgomery Avenue, and N. Apopka Avenue, E. Dampier Street, Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Avenue and Grace Street also close.
tip: Bring blankets and lawn chairs and arrive early, since roads close around 10:45 AM.
